description: This file is a C header (.h) file defining interfaces for MDIO operations specific to the RT2880 chipset, including function declarations for link adjustment, register read/write, and port initialization, along with header guards.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_link_adjust
methods.description: Adjusts the MDIO link settings for a given network interface.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_read
methods.description: Reads a value from a specific MDIO register via the MDIO bus.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a specific MDIO register via the MDIO bus.

methods.name: rt2880_port_init
methods.description: Initializes port settings for the RT2880 device.
